parametrized_description: A farmer creates plant nutrition by mixing fertilizers A and B. Each kg of A contains NitrogenA nitrogen, PhosphoricAcidA phosphoric acid, VitaminAA vitamin A, and VitaminDA vitamin D. Each kg of B contains NitrogenB nitrogen, PhosphoricAcidB phosphoric acid, VitaminAB vitamin A, and VitaminDB vitamin D. The mix must have at least MinNitrogen nitrogen and MinPhosphoricAcid phosphoric acid, and at most MaxVitaminA vitamin A. Minimize total vitamin D.

NitrogenA.description: Units of nitrogen per kg of fertilizer A

NitrogenB.description: Units of nitrogen per kg of fertilizer B

PhosphoricAcidA.description: Units of phosphoric acid per kg of fertilizer A

PhosphoricAcidB.description: Units of phosphoric acid per kg of fertilizer B

VitaminAA.description: Units of vitamin A per kg of fertilizer A

VitaminAB.description: Units of vitamin A per kg of fertilizer B

VitaminDA.description: Units of vitamin D per kg of fertilizer A

VitaminDB.description: Units of vitamin D per kg of fertilizer B

MinNitrogen.description: Minimum required units of nitrogen in the nutrition

MinPhosphoricAcid.description: Minimum required units of phosphoric acid in the nutrition

MaxVitaminA.description: Maximum allowed units of vitamin A in the nutrition

AmountA.description: Kilograms of fertilizer A to use

AmountB.description: Kilograms of fertilizer B to use

constraints.description: Total nitrogen must meet minimum requirement.

code.gurobipy: model.addConstr(NitrogenA * AmountA + NitrogenB * AmountB >= MinNitrogen, name="MinNitrogen")

constraints.description: Total phosphoric acid must meet minimum requirement.

code.gurobipy: model.addConstr(PhosphoricAcidA * AmountA + PhosphoricAcidB * AmountB >= MinPhosphoricAcid, name="MinPhosphoric")

constraints.description: Total vitamin A must not exceed maximum allowed.

code.gurobipy: model.addConstr(VitaminAA * AmountA + VitaminAB * AmountB <= MaxVitaminA, name="MaxVitA")

constraints.description: Amounts of fertilizers must be non-negative.

objective.description: Minimize total vitamin D in the nutrition.
